title: Mid-senior data scientist vs ML content-marketing keyword trap
description: A 5-year Python/pandas/scikit-learn/PyTorch data scientist evaluated against 8 postings: one strong same-family match with Spark/SageMaker gaps, one adjacent ML-engineer match, one content-marketing trap stuffed with ML keywords, one marginal analytics-engineering role, and four cross-family distractors.
rationale: The resume is a five-year retail/insurance data scientist with a classic Python, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch modeling stack. j3 is the keyword trap: a content-marketing writer role whose posting name-drops Python, pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch throughout, but the actual job family is editorial marketing — TF-IDF over-ranks it while the grading guideline scores keyword-only overlap 0. Gap target j1 overlaps strongly on the core modeling and experimentation stack (justifying grade 3) while cleanly demanding Apache Spark and AWS SageMaker (required, high) and preferring Kubeflow (low), none of which appear on the resume. j2 is a neighboring ML-engineer role where most requirements are covered, hence grade 2, and j4 (analytics engineer) probes the graded boundary with real Python/SQL overlap but a different core stack (dbt/Looker), hence grade 1. The remaining four jobs are cross-family distractors with no meaningful overlap.

jobs.raw_text:
Senior Data Scientist — Orvia (Remote, US)

Orvia powers pricing and recommendations for 200+ mid-market retailers. We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to own models end to end, from notebook to production.

What you will do:
- Build and iterate on pricing and recommendation models in Python with pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch
- Design and evaluate A/B tests for pricing and recommendation changes
- Analyze experiment results with SQL across our retail data warehouse
- Productionize training and batch scoring pipelines on Apache Spark and AWS SageMaker

Requirements: Python, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Apache Spark, AWS SageMaker. 5+ years building production ML models and experience running a large-scale experimentation program. Master's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent experience.

Nice to have: Kubeflow, dbt, Streamlit.

Machine Learning Engineer — Fieldstone Logistics (Hybrid, Chicago IL)

Fieldstone moves freight for 800 regional shippers, and our demand-forecasting models decide where trucks go every morning. We need an ML Engineer to make those models boringly reliable.

You will train and ship demand-forecasting models, build feature pipelines against our warehouse, monitor prediction drift in production, and partner with dispatch to translate model output into routing decisions.

Requirements: Python, scikit-learn or PyTorch, SQL, and experience monitoring models in production. 4+ years building ML systems. Bonus: Apache Spark, Docker.

Gradient Media runs the most-read blog and newsletter network covering the machine-learning tooling ecosystem. Our readers devour PyTorch deep dives, pandas tutorials, and scikit-learn cookbook posts.

You will write and edit SEO-optimized articles about Python libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch, manage the editorial calendar across three publications, and grow organic traffic with our audience team.
